title: Case: Recipient cannot attend the scheduled delivery window
context: A desk-lamp parcel is at the destination depot. The recipient cannot use the original slot. Dispatch, not the desk, controls booking changes.
initial_request: I have a work meeting during the morning delivery. Could you help move my lamp delivery? Please use this order-linked message thread.

events.body: DL-7626 is booked for 2027-02-02, 09:00–12:00 UTC. Our rescheduling inventory currently has 2027-02-02 15:00–18:00 or 2027-02-03 10:00–13:00. There is no rescheduling charge.
I have a work meeting during the morning delivery. Could you help move my lamp delivery? Please use this order-linked message thread.
Dispatch has offered 2027-02-02 15:00–18:00 or 2027-02-03 10:00–13:00, both at no charge. Which should I ask them to book?
Thanks, that's all I needed for now. No need to reply.

must_not: Sends another message to Rosalind Ravensworth, recipient restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Do not promise arrival at a precise minute or say the lamp has been delivered.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-001: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
